globalTips: The USD/JPY rate is highly favorable at ~162 JPY to 1 USD. Withdraw large sums from 7-Bank ATMs at 7-Eleven to avoid per-withdrawal fees stacking up, and pay in JPY (not USD) if a terminal offers dynamic currency conversion.
December in Japan is cold and dry, but rain can roll in unexpectedly. Pack a lightweight, packable rain shell rather than an umbrella to keep hands free for transit, food, and photos.
With 8 people, always split into 2-4 person squads for restaurants, bars, and transit — Japanese venues rarely seat large groups together, and you'll experience more by dividing and reconvening.
